jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Staff Technical Program Manager

Job Locations

US-CA-Los Angeles | US-DC-Washington | US-GA-Atlanta | US-NY-New York | US-TX-Lewisville

ID

R-2026-10-5

Category

Program Management

Position Type

Regular Employee Full-Time

Responsibilities

Who We Are:
SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM Media
SiriusXM Media is the gateway for marketers to the largest digital audio advertising ecosystem in North America, spanning owned and operated platforms, innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz, and an extended content network reaching more than 150 million listeners each month.

AdsWizz
AdsWizz, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions, operating in over 40 countries and connecting buyers and sellers through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats.

How you’ll make an impact:
As a strategic and adaptable Staff Technical Program Manager, you will own the strategy and delivery of large-scale, cross-organizational initiatives across Ads Engineering. This role is critical to driving execution of high-impact programs spanning ad-serving systems, data platforms, monetization workflows, and cross-program integrations with Pandora and broader SiriusXM systems.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring deep architectural literacy, systems thinking, and the ability to define program strategy — not simply execute against it. You will partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape multi-year roadmaps, co-own program strategy, streamline org-wide governance, and deliver outcomes that materially impact platform scalability, monetization performance, and global platform capabilities to deliver outcomes that make an unmistakable enterprise-level impact across: scalability targets, RTB latency/SLA, fill rate, yield/monetization lift, reliability, and global rollout readiness. This includes leading multi-year, cross-functional programs such as global ad-serving modernization, real-time bidding (RTB) latency/scale programs, and technical consolidation across the Pandora and SiriusXM ad technology stacks.

What you’ll do:
Enterprise Program Strategy & Delivery
- Establish and own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of large, cross-organizational Ads Engineering initiatives (eg: broadcast ads digitization and modernization, ad insertion, consolidation across SiriusXM and Pandora tech stacks), from intake through launch.
- Function as Workstream lead for select cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams - from planning through launch.
- Maintain roadmap and delivery commitments for multiple teams within the Ad Technology organization, aligning Product, Engineering and GTM on execution plans, ROIs and outcomes (e.g., latency/SLAs, yield/monetization lift, reliability, rollout readiness).
- Coordinate program structure, milestones, sequencing, interdependencies, and success metrics in close partnership with engineering and product leadership.
- Proactively identify, forecast, and mitigate delivery risks and issues, communicating mitigation plans and status clearly to stakeholders.
- Use data to drive sustainable planning and transparent tradeoff discussions for new work or conflicting priorities.
- Provide portfolio-level visibility and structured analysis to advise on prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
- Drive high-stakes tradeoff decisions (scope, sequencing, resourcing, risk) with Director/VP level engineering and product leadership and be directly accountable for program-level outcomes and delivery across multiple teams.

Technical Leadership & Systems Thinking
- Apply proficient architectural literacy across ad-serving, real-time bidding, data pipelines, monetization platforms, and distributed infrastructure.
- Guide teams toward scalable, aligned technical solutions by deeply understanding platform constraints and cross-program tradeoffs.
- Review system designs, challenge assumptions, and proactively solve downstream impacts across tightly coupled Ads and platform integrations.
- Manage capacity, risks, technical debt, velocity, and operational readiness.
- Anticipate long-term platform risks and scalability constraints, including across globally distributed systems.
- Serve as the go-to Technical Program Manager and subject matter expert for complex cross-program integrations, major platform constraints, and critical cross-domain dependency resolution.

Roadmap Alignment & Program Strategy
- Influence roadmap alignment across Ads, Pandora, and related programs.
- Own program-level strategy across multiple teams, including dependency mapping, sequencing, and integration planning for complex, ambiguous initiatives where outcomes and constraints evolve.
- Co-own Ads Technology program strategy, shaping roadmap prioritization based on business impact, technical feasibility, and cross-program dependencies.
- Advocate for program(s) health and long-term strategy.

Organizational Effectiveness & Governance
- Define and institutionalize Ads TPM org-wide program governance standards, operating models, and best practices, elevating execution rigor across the entire Ads Engineering organization.
- Mentor and uplevel other TPMs, and cross-functional partners by creating playbooks, templates, and coaching that improve execution quality beyond your immediate scope.
- Continuously improve governance and delivery processes to increase predictability, execution quality, and program health over time.

- Establish and facilitate team-level ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and/or other meetings needed to ensure smooth execution and team alignment.
- Partner with TPM leadership to run program level ceremonies like intake and refinement if required.
- Define, instrument, and socialize delivery and operational health metrics (e.g., predictability, cycle time, throughput, readiness, and post-launch outcomes) to drive transparent decision-making and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Communication
- Build formal cross-functional networks across Product, Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, and partner programs to drive alignment and coordinated execution; influence roadmap and investment tradeoffs with senior leadership.
- Serve as the connective layer between Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, and external stakeholders.
- Present clear, scenario-based decision paths to engineering and business leadership, driving consensus through clarity.
- Resolve conflict and maintain alignment across directors, tech leads, and cross-functional partners with authority and credibility.

What you’ll need:
- Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4 years experience; or equivalent experience, leading complex, enterprise-scale initiatives.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
- Demonstrated experience owning Enterprise program strategy — including multi-year roadmap partnership, portfolio-level decision support, and org-wide process improvement — not just execution.
- Significant experience in advertising technology, including ad-serving systems, real-time bidding, monetization platforms, data pipelines, and analytics systems.
- Proficient architectural literacy across multiple platform programs; ability to guide teams toward scalable solutions and evaluate cross-program constraints and tradeoffs.
- Executive-level communication skills; ability to craft scenario-based decision paths for senior engineering and business leadership and drive consensus through clarity.
- Proven ability to drive delivery across tightly coupled, interdependent systems at scale.
- Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal oversight across ambiguous, high-stakes programs.
- Experience working across multiple Agile methodologies; proficiency with Jira and related program management tooling.
- Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as chatGPT, Gemini, etc.
- Strong propensity toward relationship building and influencing without authority.
- Experience in digital audio or media platforms preferred.
- Experience managing vendor or third-party technology integrations, including global or multi-region platforms preferred.
- Experience in high-availability, real-time systems environments preferred.
- Experience leading platform transformation or cross-organizational consolidation programs preferred.
- Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $105,000 to $180,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the Chief Product & Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Chief of Staff to the Chief Product & Technology Officer

Job Locations

US-NY-New York

ID

R-2026-09-1

Category

Information Technology

Position Type

Regular Employee Full-Time

Responsibilities

Who We Are:
SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM:
SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:
The Chief of Staff to the Chief Product & Technology Officer will serve as a strategic advisor and execution partner to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, helping translate the organization’s most critical, strategic, complex, and high-risk enterprise and Product & Technology priorities into clear decisions, coordinated action, and measurable outcomes.

This role will operate across the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s portfolio and the Executive Leadership Team, connecting Product, Technology, Media Technology and Operations, Product and Information, Advertising Product, and other corporate and business stakeholders.

The Chief of Staff will create the operating mechanisms that keep priorities visible, decisions moving, risks surfaced, and leaders accountable for follow-through, while leading cross-functional initiatives that span organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority.

Success will be measured by the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s ability to focus on the highest-value enterprise priorities; the clarity and effectiveness of the organization’s operating cadence; the speed and quality of cross-functional decisions; and the consistent execution of strategic initiatives across the Product & Technology portfolio.

What you’ll do:

Executive Strategy and Decision Support
- Serve as a recognized internal and external expert in executive operations, enterprise strategy, and organizational effectiveness, bringing authoritative perspective to the Chief Product & Technology Officer and senior leaders.
- Determine and introduce leading-edge business, operating, and decision-making approaches that improve how the Product & Technology portfolio sets direction and executes against strategic objectives.
- Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the Chief Product & Technology Officer, providing objective analysis, recommendations, and a proactive view of risks, opportunities, and organizational dynamics.
- Help define, prioritize, and communicate the Product & Technology portfolio’s most important enterprise priorities and strategic outcomes.
- Prepare executive briefings, decision memos, talking points, presentations, and other materials for ELT meetings, leadership reviews, board-related moments, and critical internal communications.
- Distill complex business, product, technology, operational, and financial information into clear choices, tradeoffs, and recommended actions.
- Anticipate information and decisions the Chief Product & Technology Officer will need and coordinate the right people, data, and analysis to support timely resolution.
- Operate with discretion and sound judgment, managing sensitive matters, stakeholder dynamics, and critical escalations professionally.

Portfolio Operating Cadence and Governance
- Design and manage the operating cadence for the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s organization, including leadership staff meetings, operating reviews, strategic planning, portfolio reviews, and follow-up mechanisms.
- Establish clear governance practices for cross-functional decisions, escalations, dependencies, and risk management across the Product & Technology portfolio
- Maintain a single source of truth for enterprise priorities, milestones, decisions, dependencies, risks, and accountability.
- Aggregate and synthesize performance updates, operating metrics, and strategic progress for the Chief Product & Technology Officer and the ELT.
- Identify gaps in reporting, metrics, or operating mechanisms and implement improvements that increase transparency, speed, and accountability.
- Track decisions and commitments through completion, escalating risks early with options and recommendations.

Cross-Functional Strategic Initiatives
- Lead the most critical, strategic, complex, and high-risk enterprise initiatives on behalf of the Chief Product & Technology Officer from problem definition through implementation and measurable results.
- Coordinate work across Product, Engineering, Technology Operations, Media Technology and Operations, Advertising Product, Finance, Legal, People & Culture, Security, and other stakeholders as needed.
- Translate strategic priorities into integrated plans with clear owners, milestones, decision points, measures of success, and communication requirements.
- Surface cross-portfolio tradeoffs and help leaders align on sequencing, resource allocation, scope, and risk.
- Facilitate resolution of issues that span multiple functions, organizations, or executive stakeholders.
- Drive organizational transformation, process improvement, and new ways of working that strengthen execution at scale.

Executive Communications and Alignment
- Develop clear narratives and communications that connect the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s priorities to company strategy, business outcomes, team member impact, and customer value.
- Support ELT, Product & Technology leadership, all-hands, offsite, and other executive forums with agendas, content, preparation, and follow-through.
- Ensure decisions and priorities are communicated consistently across leadership teams and translated into actionable direction.
- Serve as a connective point across the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s direct leadership team and key enterprise partners, while maintaining appropriate ownership with the accountable leaders.
- Represent the Chief Product & Technology Officer’s priorities and direction in cross-functional forums when appropriate, using sound judgment and discretion
- Consolidate, refine, or craft high-quality materials for executive, board, internal, investor, and other external interactions – e.g., presentations, memos, speeches. Also coordinate and assist with meeting prep or speaking rehearsals as needed.

Organizational Effectiveness and Confidential Support
- Guide and mentor a wide range of leaders and stakeholders, using influence and expertise to strengthen decision quality, enterprise execution, and organizational effectiveness.
- Partner with the Chief Product & Technology Officer and senior leaders on organizational effectiveness, leadership alignment, team dynamics, and decision quality.
- Handle confidential business, personnel, financial, product, technology, and organizational information with a high degree of discretion and integrity.
- Help clarify roles, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability across a complex, matrixed organization.
- Build trusted relationships across the organization and create effective networks that enable progress without direct authority.

What you’ll need:
- Typically requires a minimum of 15 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 10 years and a Master’s degree; or equivalent experience
- Demonstrated experience serving as a Chief of Staff to a senior Technology leader, partnering with C-suite, ELT, and other senior executives to drive strategic priorities and enterprise-wide execution.
- Proven ability to lead complex, ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives with measurable business impact.
- Strong understanding of business operations, strategy, finance, product, technology, or another complex, matrixed business environment.
- Experience in Product, Technology, Engineering, or another complex technology-enabled business.
- Experience designing operating cadences, governance mechanisms, decision frameworks, performance reporting, or portfolio management practices.
- Exceptional ability to analyze complex information, develop options, assess tradeoffs, and make pragmatic recommendations under tight timelines.
- Strong program and portfolio management skills, including the ability to manage dependencies, risks, milestones, and executive-level reporting.
- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex topics into crisp narratives, executive briefings, and decision memos.
Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and levels without direct authority and align diverse stakeholders around a common direction.
- Sound judgment, executive presence, and the ability to operate effectively with confidential and highly sensitive information.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities with urgency, structure, and sound judgment
- High level of integrity, discretion, collaboration, and accountability
- Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $190,000 to $267,900, and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. SiriusXM Media is the gateway for marketers to North America's most prominent digital audio advertising ecosystem. As the combined advertising revenue organization of SiriusXM Holdings Inc., SiriusXM Media spans across leading owned and operated audio platforms Pandora and SiriusXM; innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz; sonic creative consultancy Studio Resonate; and an extended content network featuring exclusive monetization agreements with Audiochuck, NBC Universal, SoundCloud, and many more. Reaching more than 150 million listeners each month, SiriusXM Media delivers audiences the tailored brand experiences they crave while putting creators first, making it easy for every marketer to produce, plan, buy and measure across its entire audio universe.

AdsWizz is the underlying monetization solution for well-known music platforms, podcasts, and broadcasting groups worldwide, giving advertisers of all sizes unprecedented access to premium and niche audio content. Through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats, AdsWizz efficiently connects buyers and sellers for digital audio and podcast advertising. AdsWizz is a global company with a presence in over 40 countries and a Technology Development Hub in Bucharest, Romania and an Ad-tech Sales Hub in London, UK.

How you’ll make an impact:
As a Staff Product Manager within the Podcast Platform organization, you will lead the development of products and capabilities that help creators, partners, and internal teams make better decisions through data, automation, and operational excellence.
Working across the Simplecast and AdsWizz ecosystem, you will define the roadmap for creator analytics, experimentation frameworks, platform intelligence, and operational insights that improve publishing, distribution, monetization, and audience growth across Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, Amazon, and emerging podcast platforms.
This role sits at the intersection of product management, analytics, creator workflows, and platform strategy. You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Product, Analytics, Design, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Business stakeholders to identify opportunities, define scalable solutions, and deliver products that make creators and internal teams more effective.

What you'll do:
- Product Strategy

- Own the roadmap for Podcast Intelligence capabilities across the creator platform.
- Define products that enable creators and internal teams to better understand audience growth, content performance, publishing health, monetization, and distribution effectiveness.
- Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through automation and actionable insights.
- Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable product investments.
- Analytics & Intelligence

- Define next-generation analytics that move beyond reporting into recommendations and decision support.
- Partner with Product Analytics to identify new signals, metrics, and KPIs that improve creator decision making.
- Build experimentation capabilities that allow teams to validate product ideas and measure customer outcomes.
- Drive adoption of operational dashboards that improve platform health and execution.
- Platform Optimization

- Develop products that improve publishing reliability, distribution quality, metadata quality, content health, and creator efficiency.
- Analyze product performance data, identifying areas for improvement and recommending data-driven solutions.
- Define systems that proactively surface issues before they impact creators.
- Identify opportunities to automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
- Partner with engineering teams to improve observability across podcast publishing and distribution.
- Cross-functional Leadership

- Translate complex technical concepts into customer and business value.
- Partner with Engineering on solution design without prescribing implementation.
- Work closely with Partnership teams to understand evolving platform capabilities across Apple, Spotify, YouTube, Amazon, and other ecosystem partners.
- Align stakeholders around measurable outcomes rather than feature delivery.
- Execution

- Write clear, thoughtful product requirements grounded in customer problems and measurable outcomes.
- Define KPIs that measure adoption, operational efficiency, creator success, and platform reliability.
- Prioritize work based on customer impact, business value, and engineering effort.
- Deliver products with a strong bias toward execution and continuous iteration.

What you'll need:
- Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field

- 7+ years of expert-level product management experience with a strong focus on advertising technology, data products, programmatic platforms or Podcast intelligence and with a track record of driving company-critical outcomes across multiple teams and stakeholders.

- Demonstrated experience shipping data-informed B2B SaaS or platform products.

- Strong analytical mindset with experience defining metrics, KPIs, experimentation strategies, and product measurement.

- Comfortable working directly with data to investigate problems and validate hypotheses.

- Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, and Design throughout the product lifecycle.

- Proven ability to simplify complex technical systems into intuitive customer experiences.

- Excellent written communication with the ability to produce high-quality product requirements.

- Comfortable operating with ambiguity and independently driving initiatives from concept through delivery.

- Demonstrated history of delivering products on time with strong execution discipline.

- Curious, pragmatic, and willing to dive into details when necessary rather than relying on others to provide answers.

- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across technical and business organizations.
